question.worked_solution:
The numerator and denominator are $u(x)=-3$ and $v(x)=4x-5,$ respectively. Their derivatives are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{u}^{′}(x) & =0, \\ {v}^{′}(x) & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the quotient rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{0\cdot (4x-5)-(-3)\cdot 4}{{(4x-5)}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{12}{{(4x-5)}^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
